title: GHC:Expanding Residual Interfaces in Hyper-Connections
abstract: arXiv:2611.31350v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Hyper-Connections expand residual capacity across parallel streams, yet restrict every branch to narrow read and write interfaces: each branch still reads a single stream mixture and writes scaled copies of one output vector to all streams. To lift this bottleneck, we propose Grouped Hyper-Connections (GHC). By partitioning each branch into parallel groups along attention heads or FFN channels, GHC supplies each group with a distinct stream mixture and aggregates their separate outputs into each stream with learned weights. Extensive experiments across dense and Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models show that GHC consistently improves upon Identity Hyper-Connections (IHC) with negligible parameter and memory-access overhead, increasing training efficiency by 35% over Pre-Norm and 10% over IHC. Moreover, expanding residual interfaces overcomes the diminishing returns of adding streams, allowing wider residual states to yield further gains.

translated_title: GHC：扩展超连接中的残差接口
translated_abstract: 超连接通过并行流扩展了残差容量，但将每个分支限制在狭窄的读写接口上：每个分支仍然只读取单一的流混合，并将同一个输出向量的缩放副本写入所有流。为了突破这一瓶颈，我们提出了分组超连接。通过沿注意力头或前馈网络（FFN）通道将每个分支划分为并行组，GHC为每个组提供不同的流混合，并通过可学习的权重将各组的独立输出聚合到每个流中。在密集模型和混合专家模型上的大量实验表明，GHC在参数和内存访问开销几乎可以忽略的情况下，始终优于恒等超连接，相比Pre-Norm将训练效率提升了35%，相比IHC提升了10%。此外，扩展残差接口克服了增加流数量带来的收益递减问题，使得更宽的残差状态能够带来进一步的收益。
tldr: 提出分组超连接，通过沿注意力头或FFN通道将分支分组并为每组提供差异化的流读写接口，在开销可忽略的情况下将训练效率较Pre-Norm提升35%、较IHC提升10%，同时克服了增加流数量时的收益递减问题。
en_tdlr: Grouped Hyper-Connections (GHC) expand residual interfaces by partitioning each branch into groups with distinct stream read/write access, boosting training efficiency by 35% over Pre-Norm and 10% over IHC with negligible overhead, while overcoming diminishing returns from adding more streams.
